page.description: Auto-generated spell list for {name}. Maintained by Spell List Bridge — manual additions are preserved (reconcile is additive), but prefer the override JSON for permanent homebrew mappings.

plan.skippedPsi: Skipped {name} ({identifier}): its override resolved to no spell items. If this is a psi-point / discipline class whose powers are features, it has no spell list — this is expected.
plan.skippedEmpty: Skipped {name} ({identifier}): spellcasting class, but no spell membership could be derived from Plutonium data, overrides, or existing lists.

preview.title: Sync Spell Lists — Preview
preview.summary: {changed} list(s) will be created or updated; {unchanged} unchanged.
preview.missing: Detected without a spell list — click to create

prune.title: Prune Dead References
prune.tooltip: Remove references to deleted spells from the generated lists (with confirmation).
prune.summary: {removed} dead reference(s) found across {lists} generated list(s). They point to spells that no longer exist and will be removed:
prune.deletedPages: {count} list page(s) will be DELETED (nothing would remain on them):
prune.overrides: {count} dead entr(ies) will also be removed from saved list edits.
prune.reloadHint: Only the module's own generated pages are touched. The dnd5e registry fully reflects removals after the next world reload.

editor.title: Edit Spell List — {name}
editor.hint: Left: everything this list will contain after the sync. Remove entries with the trash icon (they become permanent exclusions), add spells via search on the right (they become permanent inclusions). Saved changes survive every future sync; the write happens when you press Apply in the review window.
editor.typeToSearch: Type at least 2 characters to search.
editor.noMatches: No matches in the source compendiums.

sourcePacks.name: Source Compendiums
sourcePacks.label: Configure Source Compendiums
sourcePacks.hint: Item compendiums scanned for spells and classes. All Item packs are used when nothing is selected.

autoTrigger.name: Auto-sync after imports and level-ups
autoTrigger.hint: Watch for Plutonium spell/class imports and dnd5e advancement completion, then reconcile the affected classes automatically (debounced).

autoPreview.name: Review window before auto-sync applies
autoPreview.hint: When auto-sync detects changes, open the review window (with editing tools) instead of writing silently. Disable to restore silent auto-apply.

reconcileOnReady.name: Open sync preview at world start
reconcileOnReady.hint: Opt-in: run a full reconcile plan when the world loads and show the preview dialog (GM only).

assignToActors.name: Assign generated lists to actors (Spell Book)
assignToActors.hint: After a sync, fill each actor's empty Spell Book class-rules spell list with the generated page. Existing assignments are never overwritten.

autoHideSourceLists.name: Hide source lists in Spell Book after merge
autoHideSourceLists.hint: Add merged source pages to Spell Book's hidden-lists setting so its pickers only show the comprehensive generated lists.

overridePath.name: Override mapping JSON path
overridePath.hint: Path (relative to the Data folder) to a JSON file mapping homebrew classes to spells, e.g. worlds/my-world/spell-overrides.json. See README for the format.

batchSize.name: Write batch size
batchSize.hint: Journal pages created/updated per database call. Lower this if large syncs cause problems.

dryRun.name: Default to dry-run
dryRun.hint: Pre-check the dry-run box in the preview and make automatic syncs report-only.

notify.gmOnly: Spell List Bridge: only a GM can do that.
notify.planning: Spell List Bridge: computing spell-list changes…
notify.planFailed: Spell List Bridge: planning failed — see the console (F12) for details.
notify.applying: Spell List Bridge: writing spell lists…
notify.applied: Spell List Bridge: sync complete — {created} created, {updated} updated.
notify.autoApplied: Spell List Bridge: auto-sync updated lists for {identifiers} ({created} created, {updated} updated).
notify.autoDryRun: Spell List Bridge: auto-sync DRY RUN for {identifiers} — {created} would be created, {updated} updated. Nothing was written.
notify.autoReview: Spell List Bridge: import detected list changes for {identifiers} — review window opened.
notify.overrideSaved: Spell List Bridge: changes for "{name}" saved. Press Apply in the review window to write them.
notify.overrideSaveFailed: Spell List Bridge: saving the list changes failed — see the console (F12).
notify.noPacksSelected: Spell List Bridge: select at least one source compendium (or all of them for the default).
notify.dryRunDone: Spell List Bridge: dry run complete — {created} would be created, {updated} updated. See console for the report.
notify.writeFailed: Spell List Bridge: writing spell lists failed — see the console (F12).
notify.noSourcePacks: No source compendiums are available — check the Source Compendiums setting.
notify.noLookup: Plutonium's spell-source lookup could not be loaded; membership falls back to spellClassNames flags only.
notify.overrideLoadFailed: Spell List Bridge: could not load the override mapping from "{path}".
notify.noSpellBook: Spell Book is not active — spellsNotInLists is unavailable.
notify.noReport: Spell List Bridge: no reconcile report available yet.
notify.hiddenSources: {count} source list(s) hidden in Spell Book.
notify.pruneNothing: Spell List Bridge: no dead references found — nothing to prune.
notify.pruneDone: Spell List Bridge: pruned {removed} dead reference(s) from {lists} list(s); {pages} empty page(s) deleted.
